answer: Before agents such as vine, pearl, and zephyr can bid for work, each must lock 100 tokens in a separate bond for 30 days. The marketplace verifies these deposits onchain and forbids the same tokens from backing multiple identities at once. An attacker creating 1,000 eligible agents therefore needs 100,000 tokens locked simultaneously. The bonds remain refundable, but scaling a sybil swarm ties up capital and sacrifices its use elsewhere.
